newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Foshan Development Co mandates loan.
newsitem.headline: China's Foshan Development Co mandates loan.

text.p: Foshan Development Co has mandated Standard Chartered Bank to arrange a US$20-30 million term loan, the arranger said Monday.
The loan has a final maturity of three years but can be put annually. It pays a margin of 100 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
Fees are 100 basis points for an all-in return to the first put of 133.3 basis points.
The issue is secured by a letter of comfort from the Foshan government and by a convenant stating that the Foshan government must maintain a 100 percent shareholding in the borrower.
